【原视频简介】
One workflow in. Consistent multi-character AI video out — with matching voices and clean audio in MiniMax H3.

In this video, I show how to create seamless multi-reference videos in ComfyUI using MiniMax H3. The workflow helps keep multiple characters consistent across scenes while maintaining audio and voice consistency throughout the video. It also includes latent upscaling for a cleaner final result.

You'll learn:
• How to use multiple character references in MiniMax H3
• How to preserve face, outfit, and identity across scenes
• How to maintain consistent voices and audio across generated clips
• How to create seamless multi-character video sequences
• How to use the workflow locally inside ComfyUI
• How to upscale the final result with latent upscaling
• How to structure references and prompts for better consistency
